note: Re-judged 2026-11-19 after the {partial} reason was corrected (guard required features 0x2f; extended-K1 kernel booted on arm64 qemu-1562c4ae and amd64 docker-1562c4ae; a 0xf receipt refused). Parent quote, RFC 4301 Section 5.2: "Then match the packet against the inbound selectors identified by the SAD entry to verify that the received packet is appropriate for the SA via which it was received." Tested: "match the packet against the inbound selectors identified by the SAD entry". Gap: "verify that the received packet is appropriate for the SA via which it was received". Boundary producer: internal/component/ike/engine/child.go::installChildDataplane, with internal/component/ike/engine/child_scope.go::childStateScope and checkXFRMStateScopeCapabilities (internal/component/ike/dataplane/xfrm_state_scope_linux.go). The corrected reason now matches the code: checkXFRMStateScopeCapabilities requires xfrmZECapStateScope, ICMPQuote, FragmentContext, FragmentGuard and ICMPReverse (bits 0-3 and 5) and refuses unknown bits. The tagged units are unchanged since the earlier 2026-11-19 rejudgement: the tunnel and transport SAD-selector tests deliver an in-selector packet and drop source, port and protocol misses at the state selector (XfrmInStateMismatch +1; in tunnel mode both SPD counters unchanged); the boundary SPD units carry the in direction, exact port and one template and refuse an out-of-mask port; TestRFC4301TransportStateSelectorIsTheNegotiatedPair pins the transport state selector; TestRFC4301BareESPOnTemplatedSAIsPolicyChecked runs whole and fragmented bare ESP on an ESP-in-UDP state under the production SPD. All fixtures are single-pair, so per-SA isolation within a multi-pair or sibling set stays unproven. The kernel boot facts in the reason are recorded observations, not test assertions, and earn no credit here. Scoped evidence only; zero whole-requirement credit.
